description: All Markdown data-model mounts under models/, docs/, and test.md plus OCaml semantic-test-derived supplemental programs. Templates retain the documented defaults. Every concrete registry implementation must execute successfully; known aliases identify the same API explicitly. Missing endpoints and implementations without runnable coverage fail. --refresh updates the Markdown inventory separately.
